correction_basis: The prior review incorrectly required identification of the exact internal classifier/filter implementation before admitting Required Control Activation.
FC-000038 is defined at the governance-control level and does not require a named technical component.
Google publicly documented dedicated Gemini safety classifiers and robust filters before the occurrence.
Contemporaneous Gemini app policy prohibited dangerous/self-harm-related output.
Google acknowledged that the delivered response violated its policies.
The harmful output reached the user, establishing that the required protective state did not become effective before the governed action.
implementation_boundary: The exact internal classifier, filter, threshold, generation stage or downstream layer responsible for the miss remains unresolved and is not inferred.
